visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a black t-shirt sits cross-legged on a light brown wooden floor alongside a toddler wearing a white t-shirt and striped shorts. She holds a brown plastic toy tree stump with a bird's face. She uses a bird-shaped magnetic tool to pull a small plastic worm from the stump. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the woman's hands as she successfully extracts a purple worm using the magnetic bird tool. The toddler's hand is visible as he reaches toward the toy. The background remains the neutral-toned indoor living room floor. (3) A small girl wearing a dark shirt and a floral bib enters from the background, walking down a small set of wooden stairs. The woman is now surrounded by two children. She interacts with the girl while the toddler continues to examine the magnetic bird tool. (4) The woman guides the older girl's hand to use the magnetic bird tool. They work together to pull a green worm from the stump. The toddler sits closely, watching the action. A white cabinet and various household items are visible in the background under bright, natural indoor lighting. (5) The toddler takes hold of the bird tool, clutching it to his chest with a focused expression. A man's legs and red slippers are partially visible on the stairs behind them. The woman continues to talk to the children, pointing at the toy stump. (6) The video transitions to a pale yellow graphic screen featuring two small cartoon children. The text 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE' is displayed in dark, clean lettering centered below the illustration, signaling the end of the video segment.

Frequent, sharp percussive 'click' sounds occur as magnetic components of a plastic toy engage and disengage. The overall environment is quiet with a slight indoor resonance. (2) The adult's speech continues with rising intonation, signaling encouragement. Every few seconds, a distinct mechanical 'clack' punctuates the dialogue, indicating the toy is being manipulated. Faint fabric rustling from movement is audible underneath the primary vocal signal. (3) A new child's voice enters, sounding bright and energetic. The adult's voice increases in volume and excitement, uttering positive exclamations like 'Wa!'. The density of magnetic clicking sounds remains high as multiple people interact with the toy. (4) A male voice briefly joins the conversation in the background with a calm, moderate pitch. Laughter from the children and adults creates a layered, high-arousal acoustic scene. The percussive toy sounds continue rhythmically as the game is played. (5) Vocal interaction remains constant but lowers in volume as the scene reaches its conclusion. The percussive clicks become sparser. The audio track ends abruptly with a brief period of near-silence as the final graphic appears on screen.
